title: The Ash Quarry
kicker: A quarry where ash has practical value, letting the setting show resource extraction without losing the strangeness of the old wood.
hook: A quarry where ash has practical value, letting the setting show resource extraction without losing the strangeness of the old wood.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Ash Quarry turns ancient residue into industry: gray terraces, warm dust, and workers who know which piles still remember fire.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: Pale dust coats everything, the ramps, the ropes, the coughing crews. Stone ledges step down into the cut, and rope-lifts haul slabs and people up and down together. Soft ash flats record every footprint. The workers know which piles still hold heat, which...

blocks.body: Local residents or workers appropriate to the place Spidermanders coat themselves in ash Badger-Hawks raid lunch lines from above dust mice and quarry swifts scatter when ropes strain No default combatant; add only if the scene introduces one Local civic...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Lunch is eaten gray-handed in a dusty shed, hard bread, salt pork, a tea that crunches faintly no matter how careful you are. The water is kept covered, and a clean cup is a small daily victory worth defending.
